summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion for the grid transmission and distribution node identifies one obvious large-cap reference supplier, two mid/small-cap direct infrastructure names, and one highly focused small-cap hardware candidate. The cleanest underfollowed exposure appears to be Preformed Line Products because it sells physical products used in overhead and underground energy networks rather than general construction services. Powell Industries and MYR Group are less pure to tower/pole hardware but remain direct beneficiaries through substation, electrical distribution, transmission construction, and utility project backlog. Hubbell is included as the reference leader because its Utility Solutions segment directly addresses transmission, distribution, substation, grid protection, and controls, but its size and diversification make it less suitable for the underfollowed lane. Expanded the grid transmission and distribution hardware/materials universe with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane includes diversified but highly relevant grid equipment leaders. Underfollowed lane emphasizes companies closer to physical bottlenecks: transmission-line hardware, galvanizing/corrosion protection for grid steel, and medium-voltage switchgear/electrical distribution equipment. Key hypothesis: order intake/backlog at hardware and materials suppliers may precede visible revenue for line-construction contractors and utilities.
